# Use cases

{% hint style="warning" %}
**Note on generated content quality**: all content generated by the assistant is a proposal only. It must be reviewed and updated by a qualified person before use. Dastra makes no commitment as to the quality of the suggested information.
{% endhint %}

All generation features use the same window: describe the item to generate (or start from one of the suggested **Samples**), choose the generation language if needed, then click **Generate**. The proposal is displayed on a summary screen, to be reviewed before you click **Validate**.

In lists, the generation button is an AI icon placed to the left of the create button. It is greyed out if your plan does not include the feature. Each generation consumes [AI credits](how-it-works.md#ai-credits-and-quotas).

***

## Processing activities

### Generate a processing activity

Quickly generate a processing activity in the format expected by Dastra from a short description. The assistant will suggest a name, one or more datasets with their fields, a retention period, security measures, recipients, and a description.

1. In the record of processing activities, click the AI icon to the left of **Create data processing**, or click **Create data processing** then select **AI Generated**
2. Enter a short description of your processing activity, or click one of the **Samples** shown below the input field to pre-fill the request
3. If needed, choose the generation language and enable the options you want:
   * **This activity is carried out as a processor**: generates the record for the processor register
   * **Use existing elements**: provides the assistant with the labels of the existing security measures, assets and data fields in your workspace, so that it reuses them in the generated record instead of creating duplicates. The relevant repositories are listed below the option
4. Click **Generate** and wait a few moments
5. On the summary screen, review the proposal and click **Validate**

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/register-processing-create-ai-form.png" alt="AI processing activity generation window: input field, language selector, samples and Use existing elements option"><figcaption><p>Generating a processing activity with the AI assistant: samples, generation language and reuse of existing elements</p></figcaption></figure>

### Generate a privacy notice

1. Go to the editing page of a processing activity
2. In section **11. Documentation**, click **Generate a privacy notice**
3. Choose the desired format (you can customize the instructions by selecting **Custom**) and the **Notice language**; the interface language is offered by default
4. Click **Generate**: the preview lets you copy the text of each tab, or click **Export** to get a PDF, Word, HTML or Markdown file
5. In the **Export information notice** window, the **Add this file to the attachments of this data processing** option, enabled by default, adds the exported file to the attachments of the processing activity; each export creates a new attachment

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/register-processing-notice-export-modal.png" alt="Privacy notice preview with the Export action"><figcaption><p>Exporting the AI-generated privacy notice</p></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/register-processing-notice-export-attachments-option.png" alt="Export information notice window with the option to add the file to the attachments"><figcaption><p>Adding the exported notice to the attachments of the processing activity</p></figcaption></figure>

### Generate the DPIA criteria assessment

The analysis tab of a processing activity assesses the 9 EDPB criteria for a DPIA from the information of the processing activity.

1. Open a processing activity, then its analysis tab
2. In the **Assessment of the 9 criteria for the DPIA (EDPB)** section, click **Generate assessment**
3. Click **Generate** in the window that opens, then review the result

### Generate a compliance analysis for a processing activity

The assistant can analyze an existing processing activity and produce an assessment of its compliance with GDPR documentation requirements.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Beta feature**: results may be less consistent than a stable feature and should be treated with extra care. This analysis is a decision-support tool, not legal advice.
{% endhint %}

Once the analysis is generated, click **Print analysis** to export the result as a PDF or send it directly to the printer. This document can be attached to your compliance file.

### Analyze a contract, a stakeholder, an asset or a questionnaire response

The same analysis is available on contracts, stakeholders, assets and questionnaire responses. Open the record, then click the **AI analysis (beta)** button. The window shows the overall score from A to F, the assessed criteria with their justification and the suggested tasks. Use **Analysis history** to compare with a previous analysis, then **Print analysis** to export the result.

### Suggest tags

In a **Tags** field that is still empty, an AI assistant button suggests tags from the name and description of the object. Click it: the suggested tags fill the field. For tag management, see [Tag management](../tags.md).

## Repositories

### Generate an asset

Quickly generate an asset (software, tool, etc.) in the format expected by Dastra. The assistant will suggest a name, links to the stakeholder's privacy policy, and create a stakeholder as publisher.

1. In the assets list, click the AI icon to the left of **Add an asset**, or click **Add an asset** then select **AI generated**
2. Enter a description or a privacy policy URL
3. Click **Generate**, then review and complete the suggested information before clicking **Validate**

### Generate a stakeholder

1. In the stakeholders list, click the **Generate Actor with AI** icon
2. Give a brief summary of the stakeholder. The assistant searches the web
3. Click **Generate**, review the proposal, then click **Validate**

### Generate a dataset

1. Go to the **Datasets** page
2. Click the **Generate a dataset with AI** icon, or **New dataset** then **AI Generated**
3. Enter a short description of your dataset
4. Click **Generate** and wait a few moments
5. On the summary screen, apply your corrections and click **Validate**

### Generate a security measure

In the measures list, click the **Generate a measure with AI** icon, describe the measure, click **Generate**, then **Validate**. This feature belongs to the risk options of your plan.

***

## Questionnaires (DPIA, risk analysis…)

### Generate an AI-assisted response

1. Go to the **Questionnaires** section and select the desired template (e.g. CNIL PIA)
2. Click **Plan questionnaire**
3. Select **AI-assisted response**
4. Specify the processing activity to use as a source, or enter custom instructions
5. Once the response is generated, apply your corrections directly in the questionnaire

{% hint style="info" %}
When an AI analysis has been performed on a questionnaire response or a DPIA, a **Print analysis** button appears in the header of the analysis panel as soon as a result is available. The structured document includes the overall score (A to F), the general assessment, the assessed criteria with their score and justification, as well as the suggested tasks ranked by priority, without relying on screenshots.
{% endhint %}

### Generate a questionnaire template

1. Go to the **Questionnaires** section and click to create a questionnaire template
2. Select **Create from AI**
3. Provide a description of the questionnaire (300 words) and a type
4. Adjust the number of sections and questions
5. Click **Generate**

### Translate a questionnaire with AI

In the builder of a saved questionnaire template, click **Translate questionnaire**: the AI translates all the sections and questions of the template into another language. Choose the target language and how the result is saved.

***

## Data subject requests

### Generate a response to a request

Generate responses in multiple languages, with customization options (length, formal or informal tone, etc.).

1. Open a request currently being processed
2. Fill in the information up to the **Communication / Transmission** step
3. Click **Generate with AI**: the assistant generates a response based on the following information:
   * First and last name of the requester
   * Request message
   * Language to use
   * Workspace name
   * Purposes of the relevant processing activity
   * Name of the request operator
   * Request date and number of days remaining
   * Request status and ID
4. Edit the proposed text or use the reformulation options (shorten, lengthen, change tone)
5. Click **Validate this message**, add any attachments, then click **Send**

{% hint style="info" %}
A limit on the number of calls per minute is in place for this feature.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**AI Act, Article 50**: when a response is generated by the AI assistant, the strict obligation of Art. 50(1) (informing the person that they are interacting with an AI system) does **not** apply, because there is no direct interaction between the AI system and the data subject: a human user reviews, validates and sends the response. It nevertheless remains recommended to inform the data subject as a GDPR best practice (Art. 5(1)(a) fairness). See the [FAQ](faq.md) for the full analysis.
{% endhint %}

## Data breaches

### Generate a post-mortem

From an existing breach record, the assistant generates a structured post-mortem document including a description of the incident, the affected data, and the measures taken.

In the post-mortem tab of the breach record, mark the post-mortem as done, then click **Generate with AI**.

***

## Contracts

### Extract contract metadata

Import a contract document (PDF, image or URL) and let the assistant automatically extract its metadata: parties, subject, duration, key clauses, etc.

In the **Contracts** module, click the create button, then **Import your document**.

***

## Custom documents and reports

### Generate a custom document

Enter your own instructions and optionally provide source content. The assistant generates a structured document according to your specifications. In the **Contracts** module, click the create button, then **Create your document with AI**.

### Generate a custom report

From the **Custom reporting** module, click the **Generate a custom report with AI** icon and describe the desired report in natural language. The assistant produces a first version that you can then refine.

***

## AI systems

### Generate an AI system

1. In the record of AI systems, click the **Generate with AI** icon to the left of the create button
2. Enter a short summary of your AI system (name, AI model, etc.)
3. Click **Generate**, review the proposal, then click **Validate**

The same approach exists for AI models: describe the model (name, publisher, etc.).

### Generate an information notice for an AI system

From an AI system record, click **Generate a notice** to automatically produce the information document intended for users or data subjects.

### Generate a risk analysis for an AI system

The assistant analyzes the fields filled in on the AI system record and produces an assessment of the associated risks.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Beta feature**: to be treated with extra care and validated by an expert before any decision.
{% endhint %}

Once the analysis is generated, click **Print analysis** to export the result as a PDF. This document can be attached to your AI Act compliance file.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/generalites-ai-assistant-cas-dusage-analysis-print.png" alt="AI analysis panel with the Print analysis and Restart analysis buttons"><figcaption><p>The "Print analysis" button exports the analysis result as a PDF</p></figcaption></figure>

## Frameworks and controls

### Suggest controls, requirements and tests

From a framework in the Compliance module, the assistant suggests controls and tests based on the context of the relevant object (name, description, associated framework).

* **Controls**: on the page of a requirement, click **Add controls**, then **Create or link with AI**. The results are split between **Existing controls** of your library and **New controls** to create. The tests of the new controls are generated with them.
* **Tests**: from a control, click **Select or generate tests with AI**. The results are split between **Existing tests** and **New tests**.
* **Requirements**: in the window to create a requirement, an AI icon next to the reference field suggests a reference.

### Analyze test evidence

In the evidence table of a test, click **Analyze** in the AI column. The assistant compares the evidence with the test procedure and shows its **Analysis confidence** and **Details**. New evidence is analyzed automatically as long as **AI evidence auto-scan** is enabled, which is the default: you turn it off per workspace in **Workspace settings** > **Compliance**.
